digest.component_or_area: Jira write dispatch and retry budget
propositions: Jira writes across Cloud ACLI/REST and DC SDK/wrapper retries can timeout and multiply writes or leave acceptance ambiguous; establish one provider-neutral retry budget with exact summary postcondition.

Define operation/outcome contract with stable logical id, desired postcondition, invocation/request counts, disposition, replay safety, and bounded redacted diagnostics; allow at most three invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep with exponential backoff [2s,3s) then [4s,5s).

Cloud executor makes one ACLI process per write and recovers summary via primary-store REST get_issue_by_rest with one attempt and no sleep; DC executor uses Jira 3.10.5 with max_retries=0 and performs GET-PUT-GET sequence per invocation with per-call one-attempt/no-sleep policy.

Successful observation of desired summary after timeout means recovered success; ambiguous or failed observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown; over-budget provider delay returns retry_not_before without sleep.

Handler records exactly one redacted per-mutation message capped at 512 Unicode code points and emits one redacted completion log per terminal outcome with logical id, disposition, counts, cleanup status, and retry_not_before, all capped at 1024 Unicode code points.

Constructor-injected executor selector defaults to legacy in S1, requires explicit test selection, applies only to exact summary field, and bypasses generic _call_with_retry; S3 owns cutover and venue-gated validation.
